integrity: The proof reduces equality exactly to q(p+p^ell-1)=p^(ell^2)+1. For p>2 a nonzero residue has absolute value strictly below the divisor, forcing p=2; the remaining quotient is the cyclotomic value Phi_(2 ell^2)(2). The packaged computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the stratum n=p^(ell^2)q with ell an odd prime and p,q distinct primes. It does not prove that Phi_(2 ell^2)(2) is prime infinitely often and therefore does not settle the general infinitude question for sigma-star equals sigma-e.
title: Prime-square exponent rigidity for unitary–exponential divisor-sum equality
